mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may potentiate beta-blocker effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol can enhance hypotensive and negative inotropic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, blood pressure, and heart rate; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; counsel patient on signs of bradycardia or hypotension.
